Subject: Request for Reimbursement Invoice

Dear Workshop Secretary,

I participated in the ACL 2025 workshop on Computational Social Science. Could you please provide an invoice for the registration fee for reimbursement?

Best,
Dr. Emily Hart
University of Edinburgh

--- Email In ---

Dear Dr. Hart,

Thank you for your participation. Attached is the official invoice for your ACL 2025 workshop registration.

Sincerely,
ACL 2025 Workshop Secretariat
